question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She believed she had been__ blamed for the mistakes of others__ for what happened.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Made a scapegoat**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**Made a scapegoat**" means being blamed for the wrongdoings, mistakes, or faults of others. (बलि का बकरा बनाना)
 
• It accurately describes the situation where someone is unfairly blamed for something that others have done.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She believed she had been made a scapegoat__ for the mistakes of others for what happened.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Made a sceptic (संदेहवादी बनाना)**: means causing someone to doubt or question.
 
• **Made a spinster (कुंवारी बनाना)**: refers to an unmarried woman, typically an older one.
 
• **Made a savage (क्रूर बनाना)**: means causing someone to become ferocious or aggressive.
